text: Underway here in match five.
Robodinho signals intent to claim possession right in the centre circle.
CR-7000 is clean through down the left, nobody in the way!
Just past the upright from close range!
Robodinho loses balance in defence, immediately initiating recovery.
Real Machina are suffocating the red shirts here, pinning Synthetic Athletic deep against their own goal mouth.
Down goes Robodinho again on the left touchline, gyroscopes having a proper wobble today, though the self-righting routine is already underway.
Another spill for Robodinho, struggling for grip back there.
GOAL! Zidroid tucks it away from two metres! Real Machina lead one-nil!
Zidroid immediately calls for the press straight from the restart.
CR-7000 charges straight through midfield!
GOAL! CR-7000 smashes it home from close range! Two quickfire strikes make it two-nil to Real Machina!
Inches wide from point-blank range!
CR-7000 surges right up to the mouth!
Shaves the post from the right!
Relentless white-shirted pressure continues unabated.
The corner push-panel triggers and thumps the magenta ball back into open pitch.
Fired out by the corner panel!
An awkward mix-up between teammates as CR-7000 and Zidroid crash together right in front of goal, leaving CR-7000 on the deck.
Robodinho signals an all-out effort to prize the ball off the boundary wall.
GOAL! Zidroid slots it into the bottom corner! Clinical finishing from Real Machina, and it is three-nil!
Griezmatronn breaks free with an open run on goal!
Griezmatronn strides forward smoothly across the halfway line, orchestrating a rare break for Synthetic Athletic.
Griezmatronn drives within striking distance!
Ambitious effort flashes wide!
GOAL! Griezmatronn pounces on the rebound and bundles it over the line! Synthetic Athletic pull one back, three-one!
Robodinho confirms possession is secured out on the left flank as Synthetic Athletic look to build momentum.
A quiet moment by the right wall. Synthetic Athletic desperately needed that goal before the break after being dismantled early on by Real Machina’s relentless pairing.
CR-7000 indicates support is arriving to dislodge the ball from the wall.
GOAL! CR-7000 stabs it in from the right! Real Machina restore their three-goal cushion, making it four-one!
CR-7000 breaks clean through again!
CR-7000 marches directly into the attacking third, threatening once more.
That is the whistle for half-time. Real Machina lead Synthetic Athletic four goals to one after a dominant opening period in this round-robin clash.
Griezmatronn leads the charge up into the final third.
A wicked deflection skims just wide of the post, nearly handing away another goal.
GOAL! An own goal off CR-7000! The ball ricochets into the net and Synthetic Athletic are gifted a second! Four-two now!
Zidroid informs CR-7000 that work is underway to work the ball free along the left barrier.
Real Machina are tightening the screw again, pinning the red shirts deep in their defensive third.
Griezmatronn breaks into open space with nobody ahead to block the route!
A massive chance goes begging right in the goal mouth, skipping wide by less than a metre!
CR-7000 signals the clearance attempt.
Griezmatronn hits the deck right in the goal mouth at the crucial moment.
The corner panel ejects it!
Robodinho is clean through!
Robodinho flattens CR-7000 in midfield!
Zidroid retaliates and topples Robodinho!
And now Zidroid goes down in a chaotic scramble! Units tumbling everywhere in this breathless phase of play!
A much-needed reset as both sides regain their balance. Synthetic Athletic have shown tremendous grit to stay in this contest against the league leaders.
Zidroid regains control, carrying the ball methodically through the centre of the pitch.
Zidroid calls for the clearance.
Real Machina are squeezing high once again, keeping Synthetic Athletic pinned right against their back wall as the clock ticks down.
Griezmatronn pushes forward on the left, hunting for one last opportunity.
Struck wide from point-blank range!
GOAL! Robodinho turns it home right on the goal line! Synthetic Athletic make it three-four, setting up a frantic finish!
Full time: Synthetic Athletic three, Real Machina four, a pulsating thriller ends with Machina taking the spoils.
